modes.cue_notes: Lie flat on the back with arms and legs relaxed, palms facing up. A brief, simple settling point used to absorb intensity between active poses before continuing the flow.

breathing_cues.entering: Exhale as you lower the whole body down onto the floor, releasing all effort.
breathing_cues.holding: Let the breath return to its own natural rhythm without adjustment.
breathing_cues.exiting: Inhale as you gently begin to bring movement back into fingers and toes.

notes: Minimal-geometry rebound node; used to give the nervous system a brief reset after intense standing or backbend work before resuming the sequence.
